limitations: System ownership counters cover successful requests delegated through SpillAlloc, not malloc usable size, metadata, retained arenas, foreign allocation or direct runtime mappings.
Request and glibc observations are process-wide and non-atomic. Their difference is not an exact foreign-allocation measurement or an admission bound.
Other caller/driver threads, cached thread storage, opaque/shared driver memory and overlapping worker/coordinator lifetimes still need enforced ownership bounds.
Ordinary workload admission remains closed for incomplete lifetime profiles.

All maintained proving families/routes, broader/live-cache workloads, five matched throughput pairs, 24 hours AND 150 roots, full-64/deadline/depth/size gates, multiple GPUs, AMD/Metal and newer Apple source integration remain open.
